Url.Name: Relay address
Url.Hint: Copy this from the relay web page. It starts with ws:// or wss://. If Foundry uses https, the address must start with wss://.

Key.Name: Connect key
Key.Hint: Copy this from the relay web page.

Enabled.Name: Connect this browser to the relay
Enabled.Hint: Turn on for one dedicated GM browser tab. Leave off for players.

Status.NoSettings: Rest Relay: set the relay address and connect key in module settings.
Status.BadKey: Rest Relay: the relay rejected the connect key. Copy it again from the relay page.
Status.Replaced: Rest Relay: another browser took over the link.

Panel.ConnectedDetail: The relay can see this browser and send it commands.
Panel.ConnectingDetail: Trying to reach the relay. It will keep retrying by itself.
Panel.OffDetail: Turn on "Connect this browser to the relay" and save.
Panel.NoSettingsDetail: Fill in the relay address and the connect key, then save.
Panel.BadKey: Not connected: the relay rejected the key
Panel.BadKeyDetail: Copy the connect key again from the relay page, paste it here and save.
Panel.Replaced: Not connected: another browser took over
Panel.ReplacedDetail: Only one browser can be linked. Use Reconnect here to take it back.
Panel.Pending: You have changes that are not saved yet. Click Save Changes to use them.

Check.AddressEmpty: Paste the relay address from the relay web page.
Check.AddressBad: That is not a web address. It should look like wss://rest-relay.example.com
Check.AddressHttp: Use wss:// or ws:// here, not http:// or https://.
Check.AddressNeedsWss: Foundry is on https, so the address must start with wss://.
Check.KeyEmpty: Paste the connect key from the relay web page.
Check.KeySpaces: The key has spaces in it. Copy it again with no extra spaces.
Check.KeyShort: The key looks too short. Copy the whole key.
